headline: Oil Prices Plunge Amid Shift in Iran Policy Expectations
summary: Oil prices dropped sharply, putting the commodity on track for its largest one-week decline since 2020 following shifting expectations regarding Iran policy.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity and energy input, driving inflation expectations, transportation costs, and corporate earnings across multiple sectors.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Oil prices dropped significantly as market expectations shifted regarding the Iran playbook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Oil prices fell sharply due to shifting political expectations altering the outlook on Iranian oil supply.
